toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Binne die familie' says more clearly that the skill is learnt from family members; 'in die familie' reads like 'it runs in the family'.
toegepas.fout: 'leer dit in die familie' is loose and echoes 'dit loop in die familie', blurring that the skill is learnt from relatives.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Binne die familie' is the natural phrasing for learning from family members and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Die gebruike van die tradisie word ook stap vir stap geleer.
toegepas.na: Daarby word die gebruike van die tradisie stap vir stap geleer.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids a second 'ook' straight after the previous sentence's 'ook' while keeping the additive meaning.
toegepas.fout: Two consecutive sentences lean on 'ook', which reads repetitive.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Daarby' keeps the additive link without the repeated 'ook', and nothing else in the sentence moves.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Geïdentifiseer' is a formal loanword; 'herken' is the plain Afrikaans word a Grade 6 learner knows.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Geïdentifiseer' is standard Afrikaans a Grade 6 reader knows, so this is a lateral move in a heading, and 'herken' would sit awkwardly beside the paragraph's closing 'erken'.

laat_vaar.blok: Erkenning aan die einde van die opleiding
laat_vaar.voor: Aan die einde word die leerling
laat_vaar.na: Aan die einde van die leertyd word die leerling
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Aan die einde' has no stated reference in the sentence itself; naming the leertyd makes it clear without adding content.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The block heading and the previous paragraph already make clear what 'Aan die einde' refers to, and adding 'leertyd' repeats the word the paragraph closes on.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In the glossary sentence 'word tekens ... gelees as so 'n roeping om 'n geneser te word' the participle stands before the as-phrase; natural Afrikaans word order puts it at the end ('word tekens soos ... as so 'n roeping gelees om 'n geneser te word'). The protected wording itself forces the less natural order; a person may want to protect 'as so 'n roeping gelees' instead.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: lees dan gewoonlik die tekens as
laat_vaar_vorige.na: sien dan gewoonlik die tekens as
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: "Lees ... as" for interpreting signs follows English "read as"; "sien ... as" is the natural Afrikaans and keeps gewoonlik.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Tekens lees' is natural Afrikaans for interpreting signs and carries the expert's interpretation that 'sien' weakens; it also matches the glossary entry's 'gelees'.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: "Doen" needs an object here; "dit self te doen" completes the phrase.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Leer deur self te doen' is a natural fixed phrase (learning by doing) and the added 'dit' has no clear antecedent.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: leer deur saam met die geneser te werk
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: "Saam te werk" leaves unsaid with whom; naming the geneser makes the definition clear when read alone.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The entry already says 'by 'n ervare geneser', so it is clear with whom the learner works, and the change would repeat 'geneser' in a shared definition.
